"""Row W2-L423's rule: every 40-hex commit or tree id in this folder's logs and XML shortened to 12 digits."""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LONG = re.compile(r"(?<![0-9a-f])([0-9a-f]{12})[0-9a-f]{28}(?![0-9a-f])")

for path in sorted(HERE.iterdir()):
    if path.suffix in (".log", ".xml", ".marker") and path.is_file():
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        short, n = LONG.subn(r"\1", text)
        if n:
            path.write_text(short, encoding="utf-8")
        print(path.name, n)
sys.exit(0)
